Unresolved information

  • Absolute precursor charges, injected stock amount, stock aging/speciation and quantitative Pb-cHxBu molecular identity are not established.
  • Several heating rates, withdrawal volumes, separation settings, purification solvent ratios and final storage conditions are unreported.
  • No measured atomic-coordinate file or raw electronic transport/spectral array is supplied.

Source distinctions and conflicts

  • Methods/body intermediate stock is 0.5:1.2:50; Figures 1 and 4 captions print 0.5:1:50. Figure 2 caption instead identifies high stock 1:2.5:50 while body associates its 90 min wires with intermediate stock. Figure-specific sample links remain unresolved.
